findings.title: A Connection Can End in Controlled Closure
findings.claim: Following a connection can culminate in deciding where passage must be cut off; the same linkage that opens reach can be turned toward a controlled discontinuity.
findings.mechanism: The focus's connection and succession meet the later gap, filling, and blocked-opening occurrences: the barrier is built between sides and cannot be climbed or pierced.
findings.reader_payoff: Connection becomes perceptible as something that can organize a boundary, not only maximize passage.
findings.containment: This is a productive reversal in an attributed outlier, not a replacement lexical gloss for sabab and not a claim that following normally means closure.

epistemic.reason: The focus and barrier coordinates are exact, but the source is an outlier with legacy-unbound provenance and an explicitly surprising inference.

findings.title: The Telling Follows the Journey
findings.claim: The repeated hinge may make the telling imitate the action: the recital follows episode after episode as the traveler follows one means after another.
findings.mechanism: 18:83 introduces a recitation of the account, while the same following-a-means hinge appears at 18:85, 18:89, and 18:92; the recurrence contacts narrative sequence with travel sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The short focus clause becomes perceptible as both a movement in the account and a formal cue that carries the account forward.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory compositional echo, not the lexical meaning of the focus sentence and not a replacement for the narrated travel.

epistemic.reason: The exact repeated clauses and recitation anchor are supplied, but the formal-mimesis inference is outlier material from a legacy-unbound source.

findings.title: The Route Under a Request for Guidance
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:6 overlay lets the followed means be heard as a route whose value is also direction toward a sought straight path.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun carries a target-reaching means, while 1:6 supplies an independent request to be guided along a straight path; their contact returns through the focus verb and noun without changing the focus text.
findings.reader_payoff: The route is newly perceptible as something sought under direction, not only as capacity that happens to be available.
findings.containment: This external overlay does not equate sabab with ṣirāṭ, identify the focus route with a single theological path, or suppress the native pericope readings.

epistemic.reason: The external ayah and its root occurrences are explicitly supplied, but the packet provides no separate trust label for this overlay and no focus-word morphology beyond the focus surface record.
